item.title: [SwiftHFR] Duo fold test: Messages logged in, conversation checked after the folded list's reload (#1124)
item.body:
LOT-147
Closes #1124
Claim: mac/M1
Author model: Claude Opus 5.5 (mac/M1-f1124-opus)
Reviewer model: Fable 5.1 (mac/M1-f1124-fable-review)

### Problem
`DuoLayoutHostedTests/aFoldShowsTheTopicOpenInTheTab(tab: .messages)` (#1115) went red at `DuoLayoutTests.swift:294` (before the fold), then `:298`, locally and in CI (#1122, run 44306381806: stacks `[["Messages"], [""]]`, then `[["Messages"]]` once folded).

### Cause
Test setup, not app code. `host()` built the Messages list with the default `isLoggedIn: { false }` (`MessageListModel.swift:75`), while Favoris is built logged in. `MessageListView` loads the list each time it appears (`.task { await model.onAppear() }`), and a logged-out load answers `.signedOut`, which closes the open conversation (`MessageListModel.swift:357`, `if loader.value == .signedOut { selected = nil }`). So the case raced the reader's title against that load: it passed only when the reader showed `Sujet 7 p1` first.

Evidence (temporary prints, not committed, iPhone 18 Pro simulator): every red run logs `load signedOut clears selected=topic:prive-7` after the test set the selection, and at `:294` `selected=nil signedOut=true`. `rootSwapped` (the suspect in #1115's Fable round 2) is not involved: in the Messages case it is not called before the fold, and every call ran with `messages.selected=nil`. The same log also explains the R1 mutation note of that review: its red at `:294` came from this load, not from the mutated `rootSwapped`.

App behaviour is right: a logged-out list must not keep a conversation open, and a logged-in reload (the fold's new list) keeps it. That is the LOT-126 spec (`docs/lots/LOT-126-mp-list.md`, rows "Logged out" and "Session refused": the open conversation is closed), and legacy drops the selections when the account goes (`handleCurrentAccountChange` calls `clearTopicSelections()`, `MainWindow.swift:2521-2531` @ 87fe0d1c) and empties the MP list logged out (`MPListViewModel.clearForLoggedOut`, `MPListView.swift:327-334` @ 87fe0d1c).

### Change
`App/SwiftHFRTests/Root/DuoLayoutTests.swift` only:
- the Messages model is logged in (`isLoggedIn: { true }`), as Favoris;
- the Messages case waits for the split list's first load to end before the fold, so the load counted afterwards is the cover screen's own;
- it then waits for that load (`FakePrivateMessages.requests` grows, loader idle), gives `load()` the main-actor hop it takes after `isLoading` drops plus a layout pass (500 ms, as `aTopicClosedOnTheCoverScreenDoesNotComeBackUnfolded`), and checks both `messages.selected` is still conversation 7 and its title is still shown, so a loss at that reload cannot hide behind the frames before it (round 1, Fable).
Nothing wider: no other hosted test selects a conversation on a logged-out list (`grep messages.selected =` in `App/SwiftHFRTests`).

### Tests
`DuoLayoutHostedTests` (5 tests), iPhone 18 Pro simulator:
- before: red 8/10 alone, 10/10 under load (10 busy loops), always the Messages case at `:294` then `:298`;
- after (first commit): green 20/20 alone, 20/20 under load; iPhone Duo simulator 10/10;
- after round 1: green 20/20 under load (iPhone 18 Pro), 10/10 on the iPhone Duo;
- mutation M1, a real fold dropping the conversation (`messages.selected = nil` in `RootModel.rootSwapped`): red at the fold checks only, not before the fold (run on the first commit);
- mutation M3, a logged-in reload dropping it (`selected = nil` on loads after the first in `MessageListModel.load`): red only at the new checks, 5/5 after round 1 (`:314` selection, `:315` title); the fold check before them passed;
- whole `SwiftHFRTests` target once on the iPhone 18 Pro: 2090 tests in 269 suites, green.

### Device check
None: test-only change.

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, mac/M1-f1124-fable-review, c2eeec55)** — **APPROVE**

Cause confirmed from the code: `MessageListModel.init` defaults `isLoggedIn` to `{ false }` (`MessageListModel.swift:75`), `MessageListView` runs `onAppear` on every appearance (`:77`), and a `.signedOut` answer sets `selected = nil` (`:357`), which `MessagesRootView.onChange` turns into `column = .sidebar`. `diag-1.log:178` shows exactly that after the test's selection; `rootSwapped` ran only with `selected=nil`. Test-only fix; the fold path is now proved for Messages: `mut1-1.log` is red at `:303` and `:307` only, never at `:294` (round-2 Low of #1115 closed).

App behaviour: not changed here and consistent with legacy. The rule is LOT-126's (`6324335a`, spec rows "Logged out" / "Session refused"); legacy drops the open topics when the account goes nil (`clearTopicSelections()` in `handleCurrentAccountChange`, `MainWindow.swift:2531-2533` @ 87fe0d1c) and empties the MP list (`MPListView.swift:327-334`).

1. **Low** — `App/SwiftHFRTests/Root/DuoLayoutTests.swift:305-307`: `loader.isLoading` turns false inside `ContentLoader.finish` (`ContentLoader.swift:61`), one main-actor hop *before* `load()` resumes and applies `selected = nil` (`:357`), and `shows(title)` at `:307` reads the stacks without a layout pass. Scenario: a regression clearing the selection on a logged-in reload; the 20 ms poll wakes between `finish` and the continuation → `:307` still sees "Sujet 7 p1" → false green (M3 was red once; the window is real). Fix: after the settle, a grace wait as `:279-280` does (`Task.sleep(500 ms)` then `layoutIfNeeded`), and also assert `root.messages.selected == messageThread(7)`.
2. **Detail** — `:300`, `:306`: the post-fold wait needs the folded list to load, which `onAppear` skips while a load is in flight (`:173`). With the instant fake the unfolded load is long finished (cases at 1.0–1.6 s across 50 runs), so no hang today; a `settle { !root.messages.loader.isLoading }` before reading `loads` makes it hold by construction.
3. **Detail** (L08) — PR body "App behaviour is right": cite LOT-126's rows and the legacy pointer above, so the next reader does not take it as an unsourced claim.

**Verified**: `git diff origin/dev-swift...HEAD` (one file, +11/−2); `MessageListModel.swift:75,170-175,336-358`, `ContentLoader.swift:24-67`, `MessagesRootView.swift`, `FakePrivateMessages`, `until` (20 ms poll, 30 s settle); legacy `MPListView.swift:452-474,327-334`, `MainWindow.swift:1709-1711,2521-2533` @ 87fe0d1c; logs: base 7/9 and 10/10 red at `:294`/`:298`, fix 20/20 + 20/20 + Duo 10/10 green, `mut1-1` red `:303`/`:307`, `mut3-1` red `:307` only, `full-1` 2090 tests green; no added line > 140, SwiftLint CI green; app job fail = draft gate (#477). No build or test run (read-only).

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, mac/M1-f1124-fable-review, e6337a64, round 2 delta)** — **APPROVE**

Delta `c2eeec55..e6337a64`: one commit, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Root/DuoLayoutTests.swift` only (+8). Round-1 findings all closed on the head:

- **Low 1 (false-green window)** fixed at `:311-314`: 500 ms grace + `layoutIfNeeded()` after the loader settles, then `root.messages.selected?.id == messageThread(7).id` before the title check. The hop is real (`ContentLoader.swift:61` clears `isLoading` in `finish`, `load()` resumes at `:39` one hop later, `MessageListModel.swift:357` applies `selected = nil`), and the mutation now lands there: `r1-mut3-1..5` red 5/5 at `:314` and `:315` only, never at the fold checks.
- **Detail 2 (load-start wait)** fixed at `:300-303`, guarded to `.messages`: Categories never touches `hosted.messages`, so no 30 s settle timeout in that case; `loads` is read after the wait, so the post-fold `> loads` counts the cover screen's own load by construction.
- **Detail 3 (L08 citations)** fixed in the PR body: LOT-126 rows "Logged out" (`:28`) and "Session refused" (`:32`) exist and say what the body says; `MainWindow.swift:2521-2531` is `handleCurrentAccountChange` → `clearTopicSelections()`, `:2563` is inside `clearTopicSelections`, `MPListView.swift:327-334` is `clearForLoggedOut` @ 87fe0d1c, all checked with `git show`.

No new finding. Residual, not blocking: the 500 ms grace is a fixed wait, so a regression plus a main-actor stall longer than that at the exact moment is still a theoretical false green; a loader-side "applied" signal would remove it, out of scope for a test-only PR.

**Verified**: `git rev-parse HEAD` = e6337a64; `git diff c2eeec55 e6337a64`; `ContentLoader.swift:11-61`, `MessageListModel.swift:170-174,333-358`; `docs/lots/LOT-126-mp-list.md:28,32`; legacy lines above at 87fe0d1c; evidence in `runs-1124/`: `r1-load.summary` 20/20 PASS, `r1-duo.summary` 10/10 PASS, `r1-mut3-*` 5/5 red at `:314`/`:315` only; no line > 140 (`awk` over the file; SwiftLint not installed locally, CI's run is the arbiter). No build, test run or GitHub write (read-only round).
